map.百分位数（本页代码口径，线性插值法 R-7，与 Excel PERCENTILE: Percentile (per this page's code, linear interpolation R-7, consistent with Excel PERCENTILE.INC): position pos=(n−1)×p (p is a decimal from 0–1); if pos is an integer take that order statistic, otherwise take the weighted neighboring values sorted[lo]×(hi−pos)+sorted[hi]×(pos−lo); p≤0 gives the minimum and p≥1 the maximum; each data point's percentile rank=i÷(n−1)×100. Validation: empty data, or any percentile outside 0–100, prompts and stops. Grading: no fixed tiers; the median is P50, and with n=1 the rank denominator is 0 and undefined.
